# ProtocolSoup Documentation

> Docs for the live ProtocolSoup execution platform. This host is documentation, not Looking Glass and not the wallet.

## Canonical properties

- [Main site](https://protocolsoup.com)
- [Documentation](https://docs.protocolsoup.com)
- [Wallet harness](https://wallet.protocolsoup.com)

## Start here if you are an agent

- [Apex llms.txt](https://protocolsoup.com/llms.txt)
- [Wallet llms.txt](https://wallet.protocolsoup.com/llms.txt)
- [Wallet agent skill](https://wallet.protocolsoup.com/.well-known/agent-skills/use-wallet-harness/SKILL.md)
- [Agent discovery](https://docs.protocolsoup.com/deploy/agent-discovery/)
- [API catalog](https://protocolsoup.com/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [Agent skills index](https://protocolsoup.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)

The wallet is a separate origin. Its HTTP JSON API is the headless interface (issue, import, resolve, present, session, submit). QR and deeplinks are human handoffs. Apex MCP at https://protocolsoup.com/mcp is read-only catalog/decode and does not drive the wallet.
